understand.title: Understand my result
understand.intro: This explains what the checks measure. It does not explain your own result.
understand.bpBody: A blood pressure check measures how strongly your blood pushes against the walls of your blood vessels. It is written as two numbers, in millimetres of mercury (mmHg).
understand.glucoseBody: A blood glucose check measures the amount of sugar in your blood at the time of the test. It is written in millimoles per litre (mmol/L). Eating before the test can change the value, so the check notes whether you were fasting.
understand.clinician: Only your care team decides what your result means for you.

representative.body: You are the legal representative. You see only the results shared for {{name}}.
